name: Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana (Scholarship For Promotion Of Aptitude & Research In Stamps As A Hobby)
benefit:
> **Amount of Scholarship**

1. The amount of the Scholarship is to be ₹ 6,000/- per annum @ ₹ 500/- per month.
1. IPPB/POSB will ensure that the scholarship is paid to awardees on a quarterly basis (Rs. 1500/- each quarter) after getting the list from each Circle.

> **Renewability**

1. Selections to the scholarship would be for one year.
1. An already selected student can apply for the scholars
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a regular student of Class 6th-9th. 1. The applicant should be studying in a recognized school in India. 1. The school should have a Philately Club and the candidate should be a member of that Club. In case the School Philately Club hasn't been established, a student having his own Philately Deposit Account may also be considered. 1. The applicant should have scored at least 60% marks or equivalent grade/ grade point in the recent final examination. Relaxation There will be a 5% relaxation for SC/ST.
